grid.expression: SELECT EMPRESA, NUNOTA, NUMNOTA, DTNEG, DTENTSAI, CODPARC, RAZAOSOCIAL, SERVICO, DESCRPROD, CODCFO, VLRNOTA, SUM (VLR_TOT_SERV) AS VLR_TOT_SERV, SUM (BASE_INSS) AS BASE_INSS, SUM (VALOR_INSS) AS VALOR_INSS, ALIQ_INSS, EMP_ATIVA, NF_TEM_SERV, CLASS_CESSAO_MB_SERV, TIPMOV_CPA, ATUAL_LIV_ENT, NF_CONFIRMADA, CNPJ_VALIDO, INSS_CALC_OUT_IMP FROM ( SELECT CAB.CODEMP AS "EMPRESA", CAB.NUNOTA AS "NUNOTA", CAB.NUMNOTA AS "NUMNOTA", CAB.DTNEG, CAB.DTENTSAI, CAB.CODPARC, PAR.RAZAOSOCIAL, ITE.CODPROD AS "SERVICO", PRO.DESCRPROD, ITE.CODCFO, CAB.VLRNOTA, ITE.VLRTOT AS VLR_TOT_SERV, IMN.BASE AS BASE_INSS, IMN.VALOR AS VALOR_INSS, IMN.ALIQUOTA AS ALIQ_INSS, (SELECT EMP.ATIVO FROM TGFEMP EMP WHERE EMP.CODEMP=ITE.CODEMP) AS "EMP_ATIVA" , CASE WHEN ITE.USOPROD='S' THEN 'S' ELSE 'N' END AS "NF_TEM_SERV" , CASE WHEN (SELECT PRO.CLASSIFCESSAOOBRA FROM TGFPRO PRO WHERE PRO.CODPROD=ITE.CODPROD) IS NULL THEN 'N' ELSE 'S' END AS "CLASS_CESSAO_MB_SERV" , CASE WHEN (SELECT TPO.TIPMOV FROM TGFTOP TPO, TGFCAB CAB WHERE TPO.CODTIPOPER=CAB.CODTIPOPER AND TPO.DHALTER=CAB.DHTIPOPER AND CAB.NUNOTA=ITE.NUNOTA) = 'C' THEN 'S' ELSE 'N' END AS "TIPMOV_CPA" , CASE WHEN (SELECT TPO.ATUALLIVISS FROM TGFTOP TPO, TGFCAB CAB WHERE TPO.CODTIPOPER=CAB.CODTIPOPER AND TPO.DHALTER=CAB.DHTIPOPER AND CAB.NUNOTA=ITE.NUNOTA) = 'E' THEN 'S' ELSE 'N' END AS "ATUAL_LIV_ENT" , CASE WHEN (SELECT CAB.STATUSNOTA FROM TGFCAB CAB WHERE CAB.NUNOTA=ITE.NUNOTA) = 'L' THEN 'S' ELSE 'N' END AS "NF_CONFIRMADA" , CASE WHEN (SELECT LENGTH(PAR.CGC_CPF) FROM TGFPAR PAR WHERE PAR.CODPARC=CAB.CODPARC) = 14 THEN 'S' ELSE 'N' END AS "CNPJ_VALIDO" , CASE WHEN (SELECT NVL(1,0) FROM TGFIMN IMN WHERE IMN.NUNOTA = ITE.NUNOTA AND IMN.SEQUENCIA = ITE.SEQUENCIA AND IMN.TIPOIMPOSTO = 5 AND (IMN.TIPIMP = -1 OR (IMN.TIPIMP = 0 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM TSIPAR WHERE CHAVE = 'GERIMPINCREINF' AND LOGICO = 'S'))) AND ((ROUND(NVL(IMN.ALIQUOTA, 0), 2) - ROUND(NVL(IMN.PERCINSSESPECIAL, 0), 2)) IN (3.5, 11))) = 1 THEN 'S' ELSE 'N' END AS "INSS_CALC_OUT_IMP" FROM TGFCAB CAB, TGFITE ITE, TGFIMN IMN, TGFPAR PAR, TGFPRO PRO WHERE CAB.NUNOTA=ITE.NUNOTA AND ITE.NUNOTA = IMN.NUNOTA AND ITE.SEQUENCIA = IMN.SEQUENCIA AND CAB.CODPARC = PAR.CODPARC AND ITE.CODPROD = PRO.CODPROD AND IMN.CODIMP IN (7,8) AND ITE.CODCFO IN (1933,2933) AND (CAB.CODEMP = :P_CODEMP OR :P_CODEMP IS NULL) AND (CAB.CODPARC = :P_CODPARC OR :P_CODPARC IS NULL) AND (CAB.DTENTSAI >= :P_DTENTSAI.INI or :P_DTENTSAI.INI is null) AND (CAB.DTENTSAI <= :P_DTENTSAI.FIN or :P_DTENTSAI.FIN is null) AND (CAB.NUNOTA = :P_NUNOTA OR :P_NUNOTA IS NULL) AND (CAB.NUMNOTA = :P_NUMNOTA OR :P_NUMNOTA IS NULL) ) V GROUP BY EMPRESA, NUNOTA, NUMNOTA, DTNEG, DTENTSAI, CODPARC, RAZAOSOCIAL, SERVICO, DESCRPROD, CODCFO, VLRNOTA, ALIQ_INSS, EMP_ATIVA,NF_TEM_SERV, CLASS_CESSAO_MB_SERV, TIPMOV_CPA, ATUAL_LIV_ENT, NF_CONFIRMADA, CNPJ_VALIDO, INSS_CALC_OUT_IMP ORDER BY EMPRESA, DTNEG, DTENTSAI, NUMNOTA, CODPARC, SERVICO, CODCFO
